verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a general Marketing API with an audience-level resource (creating contacts for an audience). It lists Predictive Segmentation and generative AI features on its pricing page, and claims you can 'create campaigns with the AI you already use' from a chat. However, nothing in the pack shows a segment-creation endpoint or an agent turning a plain-language audience description into a segment, so the connection to this story is only glancing. Missing for 10: a documented segment-creation API endpoint, evidence of natural-language-to-segment translation by an agent or AI surface, an agent/MCP integration that covers segments rather than just campaigns, and hands-on corroboration.
